construct._note: abguard's 250 aa limit is stated as combined VH + VL, so length_ok is on vh_plus_vl_length. If it is enforced on the whole construct the linker counts too, which is construct_within_limit. Both are here because the rule is ambiguous and the two disagree for long pairs: a 242 aa pair passes on VH+VL and fails at 257 aa with this linker. max_linker_for_limit is the longest linker that satisfies the strict reading. Treat 12 aa as the floor, not a soft preference: a linker of 3-12 residues CANNOT fold into a functional Fv domain and pairs with a second copy into a bivalent diabody instead (PMID 10436086, 12856620), and a linker series measured directly stayed monomeric only above 11 residues (PMID 8577701). On this very target an anti-ErbB2 scFv was turned into a diabody precisely by cutting its linker 15 -> 5 aa, with dissociation up to 15x slower from avidity (PMID 11103810) -- so shortening the linker to fit the limit would buy an SPR number from valency rather than from the design. A pair that leaves less than 12 aa needs Fab format or shorter CDRs, never a shorter linker.

construct._note: abguard's 250 aa limit is stated as combined VH + VL, so length_ok is on vh_plus_vl_length. If it is enforced on the whole construct the linker counts too, which is construct_within_limit. Both are here because the rule is ambiguous and the two disagree for long pairs: a 242 aa pair passes on VH+VL and fails at 257 aa with this linker. max_linker_for_limit is the longest linker that satisfies the strict reading. Treat 12 aa as the floor, not a soft preference: a linker of 3-12 residues CANNOT fold into a functional Fv domain and pairs with a second copy into a bivalent diabody instead (PMID 10436086, 12856620), and a linker series measured directly stayed monomeric only above 11 residues (PMID 8577701). On this very target an anti-ErbB2 scFv was turned into a diabody precisely by cutting its linker 15 -> 5 aa, with dissociation up to 15x slower from avidity (PMID 11103810) -- so shortening the linker to fit the limit would buy an SPR number from valency rather than from the design. A pair that leaves less than 12 aa needs Fab format or shorter CDRs, never a shorter linker.

construct._note: abguard's 250 aa limit is stated as combined VH + VL, so length_ok is on vh_plus_vl_length. If it is enforced on the whole construct the linker counts too, which is construct_within_limit. Both are here because the rule is ambiguous and the two disagree for long pairs: a 242 aa pair passes on VH+VL and fails at 257 aa with this linker. max_linker_for_limit is the longest linker that satisfies the strict reading. Treat 12 aa as the floor, not a soft preference: a linker of 3-12 residues CANNOT fold into a functional Fv domain and pairs with a second copy into a bivalent diabody instead (PMID 10436086, 12856620), and a linker series measured directly stayed monomeric only above 11 residues (PMID 8577701). On this very target an anti-ErbB2 scFv was turned into a diabody precisely by cutting its linker 15 -> 5 aa, with dissociation up to 15x slower from avidity (PMID 11103810) -- so shortening the linker to fit the limit would buy an SPR number from valency rather than from the design. A pair that leaves less than 12 aa needs Fab format or shorter CDRs, never a shorter linker.
